property_summary: For any owner, spender, allowance, and subtractedValue with subtractedValue <= allowance, decreaseAllowance must succeed and return true and reduce the allowance by exactly subtractedValue; the mutant reverts on the equality case subtractedValue == allowance (and would otherwise set the allowance incorrectly), so it breaks the rule for that input.
change_summary: Replace the require condition with a check that currentAllowance is greater than subtractedValue, reverting on the equality case.
